newsitem.title: USA: Westchester, NY weighs $8 mln of bonds for Yonkers.
newsitem.headline: Westchester, NY weighs $8 mln of bonds for Yonkers.

text.p: Westchester County, N.Y., which expects to soon release its capital budget, plans to include a proposal to issue around $8 million of bonds to help Yonkers pay for an esplanade on its revitalized waterfront.
"The capital budget will be released as a proposed budget about one week from now. That will only begin the process," said a spokesman for the county executive.
He explained that the County Board of Legislators then will take up the budget, which it is expected to approve by the end of the year.
Yonkers is the largest city in Westchester County, a suburban community that runs along the northern border of New York City.
